notes: Titanium plate: a clean, bevelled cool-grey armour plate with a diagonal sheen. Drops titanium 1-2. Frames are the piece turned [-9, -3, 3, 9] degrees, lit from the top-left each time; loop them pingpong (`wrap` = 1,2,3,4,1... ; `pingpong` = 1,2,3,4,3,2,...), the game may also rotate the node.
